tests: NotificationBus ListenSignal when not already listening on channel listens on the given channel
NotificationBus backed by Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY delivers a signal for a NOTIFY that round-trips through Postgres
NotificationBus UnlistenSignal when there's only one listener unlistens on the given channel
NotificationBus UnlistenSignal when there's multiple listeners does not unlisten on the given channel
NotificationBus Receiving Signals when there are multiple listeners for the same channel when it receives an upstream notification delivers the signal to all listeners
NotificationBus Receiving Signals when there are multiple listeners for the same channel when one of the listeners unlistens should still send signals to the other listeners
NotificationBus Receiving Signals when there are multiple listeners on different channels when it receives an upstream notification delivers the signal to only specific listeners
NotificationBus Receiving Signals when the signal coalesces when it receives many upstream notifications only sends one signal to the Go channel
NotificationBus Receiving Signals when the signal coalesces when it receives many upstream notifications should send signals again after the channel is drained
NotificationBus backed by Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY does not deliver a signal for a channel it is not listening on
